description:
crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/memory.rs:118 (in Inner::objects_mut): every call to objects_mut(type_name, account_id) executes 'self.known_accounts.insert(account_id.to_owned())' BEFORE returning the map handle. This is invoked from create_object (memory.rs:508), update_object (memory.rs:532, 562), and destroy_object (memory.rs:585). Combined with the missing account_exists check in the handlers (see sibling finding 'Principal/set and ShareNotification/set skip account_exists check'), a /set request with an unknown accountId will:
  1. Pass the handler (no account_exists guard).
  2. Reach objects_mut on the first mutation attempt.
  3. Register the account in known_accounts as a side-effect.
  4. Return success on the operation (creating, then updating, etc.).

Trigger: dispatch Principal/set with create={c1:{...}} on an accountId that was never passed to new_with_accounts. The create succeeds; subsequent account_exists for the same accountId now returns true.

This is the reference backend so it directly shapes how a downstream implementor will reason about the trait. The fix is to decouple the two operations:
  - objects_mut should NOT register accounts. That's a function for new_with_accounts and an explicit register_account method (or for the create-object code path to call known_accounts.insert explicitly after a successful create).
  - update_object and destroy_object should first check known_accounts and return BackendSetError::SetError(SetErrorType::NotFound) (or accountNotFound) for unknown accounts.

Note: the sibling six MemoryBackends have the same Inner::objects_mut pattern. Same finding scope as the account_exists handler fix.
notes: Fixed in src/memory.rs: removed known_accounts.insert() side-effect from Inner::objects_mut. update_object and destroy_object now gate on known_accounts.contains(...) before mutation and return BackendSetError::SetError(SetErrorType::NotFound) for unknown accounts (backend-canonical re-check per AGENTS.md 'Caller identity (foundation seam)' / 'Permission enforcement: backend canonical'). create_object already calls known_accounts.insert explicitly after the commit. Sibling propagation deferred.
title: MemoryBackend objects_mut side-effect silently registers unknown accounts on mutation
